table.retrieve:
SELECT  
	SL.saleinvcode,
	Custcode=C.Custcode,
	AliasName=A.AliasName,
	Customer=A.Name,
	Area=Ar.Name,
	AreaCode=C.AreaCode,
	Net=Round(
		SUM((SD.looseqty*(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
		(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc)) + 
		SL.misccharges + SL.salestax - SL.flatdisc, 0)+
		Round(SUM( (SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty) * SD.unitsalestax) + 
		SUM(ROUND( (SD.looseqty * (SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
			(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc)) * SD.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
		ROUND( (SUM((SD.looseqty * 
			(SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) *
			(1 - (.01 * SD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SL.discperc)) -
			SL.flatdisc) * (SL.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0),
	Balance=(CASE WHEN (SELECT MIN(SaleLedger.SaleInvCode)
		FROM	SaleLedger 
		WHERE	
			(SaleLedger.POSTED = CASE :ac_Posted WHEN 'B' THEN 'Y' ELSE :ac_Posted END OR  
			SaleLedger.POSTED = CASE :ac_Posted WHEN 'B' THEN 'N' ELSE :ac_Posted END ) AND
			SaleLedger.HeaderNo = :ar_headerno AND
			SaleLedger.HeaderInvNo Between :ar_SinvCode AND :ar_LinvCode AND
			SaleLedger.SManCode = CASE :ar_allsaleman WHEN 1 THEN SL.SManCode ELSE :ar_SmanCode END AND
			SaleLedger.CustCode = C.CustCode) = SL.SaleInvCode THEN MAX(Isnull(B.Balance, 0)) ELSE 0 END),
	Address=C.Address1,
	HeaderNo=SL.HeaderNo,
	HeaderInvNo=SL.HeaderInvNo,
	SalesMan = (SELECT Name FROM SalesMan WHERE SalesmanCode = SL.SmanCode)

FROM    
	saleledger SL,	 
	saledetail SD,
	(SELECT  Acccode,
		Balance=Sum(debit-credit)
	From VirtualGL
	Where Acccode IN (select custcode from customer)
	Group By Acccode
	UNION
	SELECT  Acccode,
		Balance=0
	From Accounts
	Where Acccode NOT IN (select distinct acccode from virtualgl)) B,
	Customer C,
	Area Ar,
	Accounts A

WHERE 
		(SL.POSTED = CASE :ac_Posted WHEN 'B' THEN 'Y' ELSE :ac_Posted END OR  
		SL.POSTED = CASE :ac_Posted WHEN 'B' THEN 'N' ELSE :ac_Posted END ) AND
		SL.HeaderNo = :ar_headerno AND
		SL.HeaderinvNo Between :ar_SinvCode AND :ar_LinvCode AND
		SL.SManCode = CASE :ar_allsaleman WHEN 1 THEN SL.SManCode ELSE :ar_SmanCode END AND
		SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvcode AND
		SL.Custcode = C.Custcode AND
		C.CustCode=A.Acccode AND
		C.AreaCode = Ar.AreaCode AND
		A.Acccode = B.Acccode

GROUP BY SL.saleinvcode,
	 C.CustCode,
	 A.Name,
	 SL.date,
	 SL.discperc,
	 SL.misccharges,
	 SL.salestax,
	 SL.flatdisc,
	 SL.invgstperc1,
	 SL.HeaderNo,
	 SL.HeaderInvNo,
	 SL.SmanCode,
	 C.Address1,
	 A.AliasName,
	 Ar.Name,
	 C.AreaCode
Order BY 
	 Ar.Name,
	 C.AreaCode,
	 A.AliasName,
	 Customer,
	 Salesman,
	 SL.HeaderNo,
	 SL.HeaderInvNo,
	 SL.SaleInvCode

objects.name: compute_7
objects.expression: case(ar_allsaleman when 1 then 'All Sale Persons' else  salesman )
